ModMetaData.name: EPrime's Implanner
ModMetaData.author: Morten Mertner
ModMetaData.description:
Create plans for what bionic implants your colonists should get and track progress from a single overview page, with optional production and surgery automation.
Features: - Plans: Create plans of desired implants and assign them to colonists. Plans can extend and override other plans. - Conflict Aware: The plan editor knows which implants are mutually exclusive (derived from game data, mods included). - Overview: Assign plans to colonists and track progress, both colony-wide and per colonist. - Rollout Strategies: Batch by user-defined tiers, full colonist sets, or individually with no batching.
Automation: - Automated Production: Missing items are queued at your crafting benches automatically (when enabled). - Automated Surgery: Operations are scheduled when a batch is ready, gated to your best doctor or a skill floor. - Reservations: Prevents automation from depleting your resources or using all your implants.
Compatibility: - Safe to add to existing saves. - Designed for performance: cached rendering, no per-frame work, event- and interval-driven logic. - Modded Implants: Implants from other mods appear automatically, no compatibility patches needed. - Multi-floor mods (MultiFloors, Strata, As above so below II): planning and tracking work fully; automation stands down because medical bills cannot fetch ingredients across floors. - Multiplayer compatible. - Requires Harmony.
Check Out My Other Mods: - EPrime's Readouts: Replaces the vanilla resource readout with customizable groups and a stylish, modern look. - EPrime's Quality Jobs: Manage quality crafting and construction, so your items get the best possible quality. - WorkRoles: Easily and intuitively manage work priorities by assigning named roles to colonists.
